questions.learningObjective: Predict how multiplying every value by a constant affects standard deviation.

questions.learningObjective: Explain why variance uses squared deviations.
questions.stem: Why does variance square the deviations from the mean rather than using them directly?

options.text: Squaring removes negative signs so deviations do not cancel
Squaring makes the variance smaller than the deviations
options.misconception: Assumes squaring reduces the size of deviations.

options.text: Squaring is only a convention with no mathematical reason
options.misconception: Ignores the need to avoid cancellation of positive and negative deviations.

options.text: Squaring converts deviations into the mean
options.misconception: Confuses squaring with averaging.

questions.explanation: Deviations above and below the mean cancel when summed directly. Squaring makes every deviation nonnegative so they accumulate into a measure of spread.
